arguments.description: Search for tapo/camera sessions in history

arguments.command:
for session in 1f9f9926-0fe4-4761-abbb-e32543d1ac0d 2974913e-d39a-4924-a093-27e03396085b 4acad5d4-ada7-464e-99d6-d202a2d65e29 570425ed-6932-4283-bb88-ac390fed72de 5fc36dcc-a09d-40fa-8e32-2baaed85f52e; do
  echo "=== Session: $session ==="
  grep "\"sessionId\":\"$session\"" ~/.claude/history.jsonl | head -1 | jq -r '"Date: " + (.timestamp | tonumber / 1000 | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) + " | Project: " + .project'
  echo "Resume command: claude --resume $session"
  echo ""
done
